---
name: Station addition or correction
about: Request a public callsign or location update for the shared map
title: 'Station update: '
labels: station-update
---

Use **Add station** or **Edit station** on https://benhaddley.github.io/noble-skywave-fieldbook/ and choose **Submit shared update**. The form includes a structured proposal with the current shared record so the maintainer can review it safely.

Only include station information you intend to be public. Your private log and frequency approvals are not needed.
